patient_identity.statement: Figure1a marks female II:2 as affected proband; caption1b states she is43years old. This matches packet identity/sex/age. Exact encounter chronology and childhood onset are not established by the caption alone.

evidence.locator: Panel1a proband arrow and female circle; panel1b II:2

limitations: Main clinical narrative missing; packet review pending.

genotype.statement: Figure1a shows II:2 TTC/−, and Figure1c shows the c.147_149delTTC sequence finding; Figure2 explicitly calls the protein variant S50del. Coding/protein change and heterozygosity agree with the packet. Transcript NM_001354768.3 and GRCh38/VCF normalization remain unchecked.
limitations: Main molecular results and transcript version unavailable.

segregation.statement: Figure1a shows affected II:2 and daughterIII:1 as TTC/−; I:1,II:1 andII:3 are TTC/TTC and unaffected. FatherI:2 is explicitly unexamined, so the proband allele origin/de novo status is not established. Maternal transmission to the daughter is supported in this family.
limitations: Small single family; father unexamined; main segregation account missing.

phase.statement: One heterozygous deletion is shown as TTC/− in Figure1a/c. No second variant requiring cis/trans adjudication is presented; no separate phase measurement is asserted.

causal_confidence.statement: Available evidence combines one-family segregation with Figure2 reporter elevation for S50del relative to WT and altered mobility before dephosphorylation. Caption reports mean±SD and P<0.05 but does not provide the full analysis/sample context. These observations support the authors’ candidate mechanism while remaining insufficient for independent clinical validation.

access_issues.detail: Main article body unavailable from publisher preview/PMC challenge; standard EuropePMC PDF link now also returned403 HTML. Both public figure pages and images were obtainable and fully read separately.

limitations: Main article NOT fully read. Complete accessible preview and its five references, full four-page supplement and its six references, and both newly obtained public figures/captions personally read.

All assigned packet fields were read and compared against available sources. New figure evidence resolves limited identity/genotype observations, but packet remains pending until full main-text reading.
Figure2 reports laboratory observations; it does not establish clinical truth or independent replication. No wet-lab design or execution was undertaken.
